record.initial_profile_description: Delivered B1 hot source, radius scaled at fixed density; temperatures interpolated in enclosed mass, velocities/radii at boundary nodes. Coarse paired control.
record.message: The solver successfully reached the end of the integration interval.
limitations: specified convergent flow; its preparation and driver are not modeled
spherical symmetry; no multidimensional instabilities or mixing
no screening or Coulomb EOS correction
constant opacity if radiation enabled; no electron conduction
hot beta Q entirely assigned to neutrinos, conservatively
no catalyst processing, cold-decay, collection or plant-mass model

rate_update.interpolation: pchip in log(new/old) versus log(T9); frozen REACLIB shape supplies within-cell temperature dependence
rate_update.outside_table: Constant endpoint new/old ratio; relevant trajectories remain within table during burn.
rate_update.reverse_policy: Identical multiplicative factor for each forward/reverse pair, preserving the original library equilibrium ratio and Q.
rate_update.scope: Two carbon proton-capture pairs only; 27 species, other 190 rates, EOS, opacity, hydro and weak-energy convention unchanged.

record.qualification:
Paired spherical N15 size/speed controls, using the latest delivered precursor family.
Prescribed hot-flow assembly, 27 isotopes, current carbon medians, gray LTE.
record.storage_relocation: Raw trace relocated after completion to persistent workspace output; physics record unchanged.

baseline.scope: Conditional stationary heat/power/mass requirements. Hot eligibility, insulation, converter/HX/pump ratings and cold-sky view require hardware qualification. Original generic services retained; named HX and pump hardware are incremental allocations.
baseline.surface_proxy_scope: Sum of separate maxima in constant-property carbon; prompt mathematical-surface deposition is an intentionally conservative reference, not a qualified physical temperature. Finite spectral penetration and delayed heat require separate treatment.
baseline.processing_cost_scope: These named H-processing loads are compared with the retained ordinary-auxiliary allowance; they are not additional debits on top of an allowance already intended to cover processing. New requirements exceeding that allowance must be added explicitly.
baseline.qualification: Conditional integrated accounting point. Source formation, receiver recovery and guide/thermal hardware remain engineering candidates.

initial_profile.description: Exact delivered FastEOS endpoint after30us whole-fluid preparation; no energy or velocity renormalization. Preparation k0p001.

engine.scope: Conditional constant-cp cycle. Component maps, actual fluid mixture/properties, seals, recuperator axial conduction, bypass/leakage, cooler pressure loss allocation and lifetime need design. Pressure losses are included once via reduced expansion ratio. No whole-station net-power result.

cold_equipment.qualification: Linear photon/particle throughput, unchanged guide interception and chosen gas collection/repair laws. Area multiplication is a capacity scenario. New temperature-dependent leakage, bank cycling, capture and refrigerator apparatus need design. Coolant header pumping is inside the engine package pump allocation.

original_selected.scope: Selected conditional plant and stage data. Fractions returned apply to eventual recovery of reusable material, not first-pass extraction. All heat missed by the hot receiver is charged to cold equipment. The full source archive and model are separate.

receiver_transport.scenario: Conditional source-response estimate, not an energy-maximum theorem or full-device capture guarantee. Natural graphite; closed spherical cavity; two-photon in-flight annihilation approximation. Missing photonuclear physics is isolated by prompt-policy sensitivity. No extra nuclear energy is created by D uplift.

original_catcher.scope: Conditional catcher-interface requirements and modeled sensitivities; not measured recovery efficiency or a qualified reactor. The underlying selected-plant.json remains the separate allocated reference.

geometry.new_mass_scope: Active carbon, posts and vias substitute inside the350kg/m² stock. Added gas seals, compressors, valves and rework tools remain service hardware; no zero hardware-mass credit is claimed.

buffer_capacity.scope: Full-incident H/He source capacity response within enclosed warm buffer, not central cavity pressure.

requirements: Complete hot pump and local booster
Capture and retention under mixed irradiation
Capsule response to the full gas/dust environment
Recovery equipment, seals and service-mass closure
